name: r_code
text:
library(shiny)
library(bslib)

ui = page_fillable(
  h2("Car explorer"),
  layout_columns(
    plotOutput("plot", brush = "brush"),
    card(textOutput("n"), tableOutput("selected"), downloadButton("download", "Download CSV"))
  )
)

server = function(input, output) {
  picked = reactive(brushedPoints(cars_df, input$brush, xvar = "wt", yvar = "mpg")[c("name", "wt", "mpg", "hp")])
  output$plot = renderPlot(plot(mpg ~ wt, cars_df, pch = 19))
  output$n = renderText(paste(nrow(picked()), "selected"))
  output$selected = renderTable(picked())
  output$download = downloadHandler("selected.csv", function(file) write.csv(picked(), file, row.names = FALSE))
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

text: See [`jev-router.ts`](../examples/extensions/jev-router.ts) for a complete router. It keeps the phase as router state.

name: cjk
text:
数据框 mtcars 有 32 行和 11 列。平均油耗为 20.09 英里每加仑，气缸数越多，油耗越高。
回归模型显示，重量每增加一千磅，油耗平均下降 5.34。模型的决定系数为 0.75。
データフレームには欠損値がありません。次のステップでは、変数ごとの分布を確認し、外れ値を調べます。
한국어 요약: 결측값이 없고 모델은 안정적입니다.
结论：在发送报告之前，请先检查残差图和影响点，并将结果保存为 CSV 文件。
